design_principle: Strict component isolation: one failed update must identify the exact responsible component and permit isolated rollback without affecting unrelated components

update_groups.why_grouped: Independent Go binary with zero dependency on Node or Python packages. Routes to all LLMs.
update_groups.validation_gate: Candidate binary passes -config config.yaml test, binds 8080, responds to /health and /v1/models
update_groups.rollback_boundary: Isolated binary rollback (restore llama-swap.exe from backup). Zero impact on models or UI.

update_groups.why_grouped: Independent official prebuilt binary used exclusively for Qwen3-Next.
update_groups.validation_gate: Candidate boots with Qwen3-Next weights + draft-mtp flags, passes test prompt generation
update_groups.rollback_boundary: Isolated versioned directory rollback (llama-mainline\<build>). Zero impact on Qwen 3.8 or Ornith.

update_groups.why_grouped: Custom MSVC build used for Qwen 3.8 (vision + MTP n_max=3) and Ornith (MTP n_max=1).
update_groups.validation_gate: Candidate boots Qwen 3.8 with --mmproj, verifies MTP speculative buffer, boots Ornith, passes test prompt
update_groups.rollback_boundary: Isolated binary rollback (ik_llama\bin\llama-server.exe). Zero impact on Qwen3-Next.

update_groups.why_grouped: TIGHTLY COUPLED. Updating agent-canvas overwrites build/ index.html and JS assets, requiring immediate re-patching and localization parity verification.
update_groups.validation_gate: Localization parity = 0 missing keys, patcher returncode = 0, ingress port 8000 responds HTTP 200
update_groups.rollback_boundary: Complete agent-canvas folder restoration from OpenHands-Update\backups\openhands\

update_groups.why_grouped: Decoupled peripheral tools with infrequent updates. Updates should only be triggered manually upon specific need.
update_groups.validation_gate: Voice healthcheck on 18002; Android MCP stdio handshake with adb
